accepted_actual_arbitration.rationale: The resolver is correct that atomic publication, one shared CL, real current-mode answers, contiguous revision evidence and exact mechanical finalization are suitably bounded. The critic identifies a material completion gap in the exact sealed plan: line23 explains how an explicit later C editor satisfies a recheck, but supplies no executable path for A-editor then B-interview when B semantically revises the task and C is absent. Existing plugin-invocation start/prepare creates stages from the entire frozen configuration and advances a satisfied prefix; it cannot selectively revisit accepted A. Node frozenPlan independently reconstructs the full owned configuration and rejects a caller-supplied reduced configuration. Preserving a stale A or restarting B violates the approved affected-recheck contract; permanently holding an otherwise supported configuration is not completion. Revise narrowly: the owning CL registers an exact affected editorial recheck mandate derived from the frozen original occurrence, application role, parameters/package/configuration/watch identity, current task fingerprints and current mode/authority/epoch. Execute the mandate as one fresh ordinary HC/HI through the existing prepare/invoke/record/accept path. Existing owned manifest reconstruction must validate the original frozen configuration and derive only that authenticated affected selection; arbitrary caller subsets, parameters or completed chains cannot authorize the recheck. Preserve the original HC/HI and accepted prefix unchanged, with no second actor broker or independent ledger. Final acceptance may consume only the exact CL-registered current recheck result. A matching explicit C can discharge the same obligation once and creates no fourth invocation. Add actual A-B-without-C and editor-only post-revision controls, repeated editorial occurrences/parameters, no B replay, matching C reuse, forged or stale mandate/subset rejection and source/policy drift. Retain current prerequisite, provenance, final-acceptance and exact finalization guards. This is a bounded technical plan repair within task115, not acceptance of implementation, candidate efficacy, installation consent or task114 trials.

resolver.rationale: The plan is sufficient for the admitted optional post-processing application scope. The current process implementation publishes Ready tasks without a linked CL, while Store.save already supports atomic extra records; the proposed first Red therefore tests the actual missing business boundary. Trusted generic application roles, frozen configuration and exact output ownership preserve arbitrary compatible ordering, repeated occurrences and core-only behavior without candidate-ID routing. The plan separates raw pinned upstream instructions and user-only/native metadata from the explicitly declared source-backed translation, retains the grilling sibling and license, and requires real fresh fact exploration where needed. One CL owns dependent rounds, actual current-mode answers, guarded revisions and separate final acceptance; contiguous revision evidence closes the multi-round gap without restarting the external interview. Current-input editorial rechecks remain distinct from configured calls, and a matching later C pass can discharge the affected recheck once. Exact finalization is narrowly limited to the recorded owned marker/status transformation, live after-bytes, current CL policy/acceptance and registered original completed HC hashes; it preserves original HC and confirmation history and cannot normalize arbitrary edits. Required hold, drift, cancellation, mode-switch, cleanup and adversarial controls are explicit. The reviewed footprint may use existing helper/runtime seams only after concrete touched sources enter validation. This accepts the implementation plan, not successful execution, installation consent, native/candidate effectiveness or task114 trials.

critic.rationale: The plan adequately bounds atomic blocked publication, real current-mode answers, multi-round contiguous CL revision evidence and exact marker/status finalization. Existing requirementPlan is metadata-only and deliberately skips the business handler; actual Pending/proposal/source/allocated-T validation before inspection and inside the Process writer can authenticate prospective output inspection without inventing a new Node endpoint. One material implementation gap remains: the editor A then interview B configuration with no explicit C. After B changes the task, A's accepted wording input is stale and the agreed contract requires an affected editorial recheck without restarting B or replaying the whole prefix. The plan explains how an explicit current C discharges that obligation but does not define the no-C path. Current engine cursor/resume only retries the current original and cannot selectively replay an accepted stage; Node frozenPlan rebuilds the full verified configuration and rejects an arbitrary reduced configuration. Merely retaining the hold leaves a supported configuration unable to finish; silently reusing A or restarting B violates acceptance. Revise narrowly to define an owned CL-bound recheck execution: preserve the original HC/HI and accepted prefix unchanged, derive a fresh affected editorial-only recheck mandate from the frozen original occurrence/parameters/current task fingerprint/current policy, validate that mandate through the existing dispatcher and record the fresh actual HC/HI as an exact CL-registered recheck. The trusted mandate may authorize only the affected subset; caller parameters or arbitrary completed chains cannot supply it. A matching explicit C discharges the same obligation once without another call. Add A-B-without-C, editor-only post-revision, repeated compatible editorial occurrence and forged/stale subset controls. Keep shared CL question rounds, original B execution, task provenance, exact finalization mapping, capability/Auto authority holds and all qualification limits intact.
